content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-S7 (kill switch), REQ-I (metrics), REQ-K (docs), AC-11

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/api/llm/admin_pause.rs — POST/DELETE /api/admin/llm/pause (global toggle)
- polaris-backend/src/api/metrics.rs (extension) — all REQ-I1 metric registrations
- examples/llm-fixture-adapter/Cargo.toml — Rust gRPC server that returns canned recommendations
- examples/llm-fixture-adapter/src/main.rs
- docs/ops/llm-moderation.md — operator guide (wire-up tutorial + autonomy enablement walk-through + safety floors plain-English + kill-switch usage + reading audit)

**Rust quality**:
- Metrics use the existing metrics! macro
- Fixture adapter mirrors the classifier fixture pattern (tests/fixtures/classifier-fixture/...)
- Docs match docs/ops/quick-start.md tone

**Tests**:
- tests/llm_kill_switch.rs — pause flips effective mode to manual for every Recommend call
- tests/llm_fixture_adapter.rs — boots the fixture adapter and a polaris-backend pointed at it, verifies the end-to-end recommend round-trip

**Blocked by**: #LLM-5
